The '''"PulseHammer" series''' was a tripod-mounted [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. It was a powerful weapon, but had a lengthy recycle time on the [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]] meaning that during the cool down cycle, the cell was too busy recharging itself and the weapon could not fire. BlasTech discontinued the series due to this flaw.
